raw_text:
A xenobiology expedition uses autonomous subglacial cryobot pods to map bioluminescent mycelium beneath Europa's ice shell. The fleet must coordinate spectrometry, quarantine unknown spores, preserve under-ice telemetry, and operate without a surface uplink. This deliberately unusual query is an out-of-domain audit fixture; it must not be treated as an architecture requirement supported by the current software-architecture KB.
Actors: Cryobot Swarm Cartographer, Under-Ice Biosafety Steward
FR-001: The cryobot swarm shall triangulate xenobiological mycelium colonies from synchronized spectrometry and gravimetric observations.
FR-002: The cartographer shall reconcile asynchronous cryobot sightings into a subglacial spore atlas without collapsing uncertain observations.
FR-003: The biosafety steward shall quarantine bioluminescent spore signatures before any under-ice expedition maneuver is authorized.
NFR-001: The cryobot telemetry loop shall preserve timestamp ordering during intermittent Europan ice-shell acoustic relays.
C-001: No surface uplink may expose raw xenobiology observations before quarantine review completes.
